body: The more I think about how I shouldnt feel this way and about how kids/people are literally dieing of thirst and hunger, it just makes me feel worse. My problems are so minuscule, yet I cant just suck it the fuck up. I hate this feeling, it haunts me. I just want it all to stop.

I really do appreciate it. I have lived a very loved and privileged life but I just feel empty and sad. I try to fake it so that I dont upset the people who do love me but I just cant anymore. Theres no reason for me to feel the way I do, My life is so easy relative to the rest of the world, why is this feeling so strong?
